facts.text: Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: replaced: Wayman changed the deal so the goblins keep the upper mound and wall off the stairs instead

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the goblins agreed to wall off the stairs rather than have the mound cleared

facts.text: Wayman promised Snurk and the Free Goblin Society, now living in the upper Barrow Mound, that he will never tell King Hogboon where they are.
